title: Crispy Korean Mung Bean Pancakes (Bindaetteok)
ingredients: 1 cup dried peeled split mung beans (soaked in cold water 4 hrs or overnight, drained)
1 cup well-fermented kimchi, squeezed and finely chopped
1 cup mung bean sprouts, blanched and chopped
4 oz ground pork or diced pork belly (optional, omit for vegan)
1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp toasted sesame oil, 1/2 tsp salt
3 tbsp neutral oil for pan-frying, plus soy-vinegar dipping sauce
instructions: Blend the soaked, drained mung beans with 1/2 cup water and 1/2 tsp salt in a blender until a thick, slightly textured batter forms.
Transfer batter to a bowl and fold in chopped kimchi, blanched bean sprouts, scallions, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, and optional seasoned ground pork.
Heat 1.5 tbsp oil in a non-stick or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Ladle batter into 4-inch rounds (or one large pancake).
Fry for 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown and extra crispy on the edges. Serve hot with soy-vinegar-onion dipping sauce.
